limitations: Posthoc selection chooses the largest mean unresolved early-release attempt among four fresh repetitions; this is not a new holdout or an algorithmic gate.
Each exact chronological prefix starts empty and matches status/counters. Every retained payload equals one already archived in its matched worker.
Profiler overhead is outside comparative means; cumulative function times overlap. Structure labels are diagnostic only.

A separate exact-prefix replay starts tracemalloc after garbage collection immediately before the target attempt. Its peak includes new Python allocations and attempt bookkeeping, excludes existing prefix state and native memory, and is not a whole-process RAM bound. Results and all retained payloads match the untraced worker.

allocation.scope: New Python allocations during only the target attempt; excludes existing prefix state, native allocations and cProfile.
